set.body: Follow-up of bd-01M35BHNDCHM6YXCKYX0544TP3 (audit at docs/audits/group-volume-fslr-mapping.md). (1) spatial VolumeToSurfaceOperator and surface-view-three ThreeVolumeProjector reimplement the SurfaceSampling lookup contract: B's trilinear path and GPU float32 tie parity are untested. (2) GiftiSurfaceCodec drops dataSpace/transformedSpace and GeometricType, so a GIFTI's own frame declaration cannot reach route admission. (3) TriangleMesh lacks structural equals; SurfaceGeometry == is array identity (affects SurfaceVertexMapping and engine B's geometry check). (4) SurfaceProjectionReceipt.requestedSamples is computed, not observed, and acceptedSamples counts nonfinite values. (5) spatialJVM does not compile at consumer pin 7c3ff0a against Gale 83cac90 (DMatBuilder.writeLinear) - check whether main already fixed it.
set.title: Reconcile duplicate volume-to-surface engines and frame metadata gaps found in the fsLR audit
